what.text: This page follows refugees from Equatorial Guinea in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 424 refugees from Equatorial Guinea, and Spain hosted 51.4% of them.
After Spain, the largest hosts are France, the United States and Germany.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Equatorial Guinea, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1975 to 1978.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1974 at 1000 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 120000, at the end of 1977.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
